rationale: Sharon's TheAgentic.Ai is building production-ready AI agent infrastructure for high-stakes industries like biotech and fintech, while Saurabh has hands-on experience building agentic tools and AI-adjacent developer platforms at HiJenny AI. intro_message: Sharon, meet Saurabh Khire — an AI engineer at HiJenny AI who's built agentic coding extensions and has deep Python/backend expertise that could inform how production AI agent infrastructure handles real-world reliability requirements.
